deduplication_rule: A3 residual findings that restate an A2 finding remain listed, but are linked and counted once for primary severity totals.

findings.problem: K1-K9 criteria were frozen, but an approved post-freeze change was not forced to carry bias risk into final adjudication or to prohibit unqualified survival.
findings.scientific_risk: Criterion leakage could convert a threat seen under the original criterion into an apparently clean survival result.
findings.required_change: Use a full criterion-change record, force non-NONE bias risk after evidence is seen, require human review, and block unqualified survival.
findings.V4_resolution: Added KILL_CRITERION_CHANGE_RECORD_V4, final_adjudication_bias_status, prohibited outcome rule, and blocked state for unresolved review.
findings.residual_risk: A bias-qualified outcome can still be scientifically weaker than a fresh pre-evaluation rerun; the plan therefore preserves INCONCLUSIVE and SUBSTANTIALLY_NARROWED routes.

findings.problem: The V3 worker contract correction was present but did not yet provide a complete execution-readiness record with explicit artifact paths.
findings.scientific_risk: A worker could emit an apparently valid artifact with unclear ownership or an untracked location.
findings.required_change: Preserve the inference and reconciliation controls and add explicit output directories, artifact owners, schemas, definitions of done and a machine readiness matrix.
findings.V4_resolution: Reissued the full W01-W12 contract and readiness matrix with unique output directories and ownership.
findings.residual_risk: Structural readiness does not mean a worker has been launched; launch remains explicitly false until re-audit.

findings.problem: Threat, red-team and threshold controls were improved, but the search decision artifact lacked evidence-first and no-search provenance fields.
findings.scientific_risk: A targeted search could be opened for confidence rather than a documented evidence gap, increasing search bias.
findings.required_change: Complete the search decision schema, require repository evidence review before OPEN, record DO_NOT_OPEN/CLOSE decisions, and make package QA reject malformed entries.
findings.V4_resolution: Added the full evidence-first search log, state machine, no-search rows, and package validation rules.
findings.residual_risk: A targeted search remains bounded and cannot establish global absence; unresolved source access still blocks a survival claim.

findings.problem: The structured red-team row contract existed but did not explicitly name the claim being attacked.
findings.scientific_risk: A red-team result could be difficult to reconcile with the candidate register.
findings.required_change: Add claim_attacked as an explicit required field and validate it against a candidate claim ID.
findings.V4_resolution: Added claim_attacked and a candidate-ID referential-integrity check.
findings.residual_risk: Attack rows may still use OTHER attack_type when a new failure mode is discovered.

findings.problem: Human review status was machine-checkable, but REVISION_REQUIRED had no return route or re-entry condition.
findings.scientific_risk: A blocked stage could remain operationally ambiguous and be resumed at the wrong stage.
findings.required_change: Add return_stage, return_artifact, required_revision and reentry_gate to the clearance record and route matrix.
findings.V4_resolution: Added deterministic revision routing with owner and re-entry predicates.
findings.residual_risk: A human reviewer may still reject a revision, which correctly keeps the dependent stage blocked.

findings.problem: The named search decision log did not yet contain complete decision provenance.
findings.scientific_risk: The package could show that a search occurred without showing why it was necessary or why it was not opened.
findings.required_change: Add existing_evidence_checked_first, evidence_gap, reason_for_decision, explicit decision vocabulary and closure fields.
findings.V4_resolution: Completed the durable log schema and package QA rule.
findings.residual_risk: No search result is generated in plan remediation; the log remains a future execution artifact.

findings.problem: Claim transitions needed a dedicated packet identifier in addition to a prose provenance pointer.
findings.scientific_risk: Packet-level reconciliation could require manual pointer interpretation.
findings.required_change: Retain evidence_packet_ids and require referential integrity.
findings.V4_resolution: Preserved and machine-validated evidence_packet_ids in the V4 worker and package contracts.
findings.residual_risk: An unavailable packet remains explicitly unavailable and cannot support survival.

findings.problem: A3 restated the RA-01 residual: approved post-freeze K changes were not linked to a final bias qualification.
findings.scientific_risk: The same criterion-leakage risk could survive a superficial remediation by changing only the audit note.
findings.required_change: Implement and test the complete post-freeze change control and final bias-status rule.
findings.V4_resolution: Resolved through the same control family as RA-01; this linked residual remains separately auditable.
findings.residual_risk: Deduplicated with RA-01 for primary severity counts; no unqualified survival is permitted.

findings.problem: Every V3 worker lacked a concrete output directory and artifact ownership path.
findings.scientific_risk: Worker results could be orphaned, overwritten or impossible to reconcile deterministically.
findings.required_change: Add output_directory and artifact_owner to each W01-W12 contract and validate path/ownership in S16.
findings.V4_resolution: Assigned unique V4/W01-W12 output directories and machine readiness checks.
findings.residual_risk: The directories are planned locations; no worker is launched in this task.

findings.problem: The V3 search log lacked existing-evidence-first, necessary-search and DO_NOT_OPEN/CLOSE fields, and its artifact list contained a literal newline escape.
findings.scientific_risk: Search opening and packaging could not be independently audited.
findings.required_change: Complete the log schema and replace the malformed package entry with one canonical artifact list.
findings.V4_resolution: Completed the log, added no-search records, and replaced the artifact list with a manifest-backed canonical list.
findings.residual_risk: The search gate remains conditional and cannot be used for open-ended discovery.

findings.problem: Revision routing was incomplete; red-team claim identity was implicit; the package list had a malformed entry and duplicate graph/schema ambiguity.
findings.scientific_risk: A revision could re-enter at the wrong stage or a package consumer could read conflicting controls.
findings.required_change: Add revision routes, claim_attacked, a canonical V4 overlay, and a manifest-backed package QA layer.
findings.V4_resolution: Added routing and package manifest controls; V4 §§36 onward are the sole authoritative execution overlay.
findings.residual_risk: V3 historical duplication remains visible for provenance but cannot be used as an execution control.

findings.problem: Search log evidence-first fields were absent.
findings.scientific_risk: Search bias cannot be audited from the row alone.
findings.required_change: Use the V4 evidence-first search schema.
findings.residual_risk: Execution must populate the row before any search opens.

findings.problem: REVISION_REQUIRED had no route-back stage, owner or re-entry condition.
findings.scientific_risk: A blocked workflow could resume without repairing its causal defect.
findings.residual_risk: Reviewer rejection remains blocking by design.

findings.problem: Red-team claim identity, malformed package entry and duplicate execution-control presentation reduced clarity.
findings.scientific_risk: A downstream consumer could select the wrong schema or fail to link an attack to a candidate.
findings.required_change: Add claim_attacked, canonicalize the V4 overlay and validate the manifest.
findings.V4_resolution: Resolved under A3-ME-01 with manifest and canonical-overlay rules.
findings.residual_risk: Historical V3 text remains visible but is explicitly non-authoritative for execution.
